{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].astype(str)
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders and refunded orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Count QA and refunded orders
num_qa = qa_mask.sum()
num_refunded = refunded_mask.sum()

# Apply filters: keep only completed orders that are not QA
filtered_df = df[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask]

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = filtered_df['converted'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f'Number of QA orders: {num_qa}')
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded}')
print(f'Final population size: {len(filtered_df)}')
print(f'Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}')"}
